stories.title: GeForce NOW exploit lets you access the full Windows desktop through a simple file swap — Modder runs local AI models on Ultimate tier with 48GB of VRAM and no restrictions

sources.title: GeForce NOW exploit lets you access the full Windows desktop through a simple file swap — Modder runs local AI models on Ultimate tier with 48GB of VRAM and no restrictions
sources.title_en: GeForce NOW exploit lets you access the full Windows desktop through a simple file swap — Modder runs local AI models on Ultimate tier with 48GB of VRAM and no restrictions
sources.title_original: GeForce NOW exploit lets you access the full Windows desktop through a simple file swap — Modder runs local AI models on Ultimate tier with 48GB of VRAM and no restrictions
sources.summary: Swapping the executable of a game with a modified file will fool Steam into thinking it's opening that game when it's really just giving you unrestricted desktop access. This is against GeForce NOW's terms of service, though, so you run the risk of getting banned.
sources.summary_zh: 用修改后的文件交换游戏的可执行文件会让 Steam 误以为它正在打开该游戏，而实际上它只是为您提供不受限制的桌面访问。不过，这违反了 GeForce NOW 的服务条款，因此您面临着被禁止的风险。

sources.summary: A farmer in China followed an AI app's advice for his 25-acre farmland, resulting in the death of his entire crop of sesame seedlings. 67-year-old man was initially skeptical of the tool but eventually trusted it after months of using it.

sources.title_original: Windows 11's built-in weather app hogs more than 1.2 gigabytes of RAM just to tell the forecast — memory-sucking web wrapper filled with ads masquerades as an actual application
sources.summary: MSN Weather acts as the native weather app for Windows 11 and all it does it run a bunch of Chromium subprocesses in the background to retrieve the forecast data. This causes it to use 5x more memory than the macOS weather app. And, oh, you also get to enjoy ads!
sources.summary_zh: MSN Weather 充当 Windows 11 的本机天气应用程序，它的作用是在后台运行一堆 Chromium 子进程来检索预报数据。这导致它使用的内存比 macOS 天气应用多 5 倍。而且，哦，您还可以享受广告！
